## Problem and bounded change

Describe the reproducible issue and the smallest improvement.

## Evidence

- [ ] Local Python tests run (`python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`)
- [ ] At least one negative case or counterexample considered
- [ ] Existing tests and offline demo remain supported
- [ ] Simulated results are not described as real-model inference

## Privacy, security and cost

- [ ] No private or employer/customer data, credentials, internal controls, or proprietary strategies
- [ ] No implicit command execution, unrestricted external access or additional recurring infrastructure cost
- [ ] Limitations and user-facing documentation updated where needed

## Follow-up

List deliberate out-of-scope work rather than bundling unrelated features.
